notes.title: The Journey of Piggy is available now!
notes.content:
The Journey of Piggy officially launches on Steam today, November 7. A roguelike adventure game with fast-paced, shoot 'em up combat set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Choose from a variety of weapons, cards and power-ups to create unique builds and survive until the end.

[previewyoutube=_TbYRP8W-bw;full][/previewyoutube]

Today marks the culmination of several months of dedicated development and unwavering passion. We are thrilled to present our video game to you. We've poured our hearts into creating an experience we hope you'll enjoy as much as we do. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we eagerly anticipate hearing your thoughts. Thank you for joining us on this journey, and may you find joy in the world we've crafted.

With gratitude,
Family Devs.

notes.title: Announcement and Demo
notes.content:
We are so proud to announce our new game: The Journey of Piggy🐷🔫

[previewyoutube=ZjNQUvFlkJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The Journey of Piggy is a roguelike adventure game with fast-paced, shoot 'em up combat set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Choose from a variety of weapons, cards and power-ups to create unique builds and survive until the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881999/65ce6111e4698c64634af24f7c0e999b7a6abb8f.jpg[/img]

This demo is a sneak peak of The Journey of Piggy, to show you how gameplay works and art of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881999/9dcbaa2fd1aadcf148acdc301da6ffabace25212.jpg[/img]

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
